finding.what: Side effect of round 1's camObliqueAz 0: the plan crane still sweeps +18 deg, so the plan view now lies on a diagonal (row and stage plane tilted 42-52.5 s) and every later pose inherits the extra 18 deg.
finding.why: The sweeps add up: round 1 had -18 then +18 = 0 in plan. With the oblique at 0, a plan sweep of 0 restores the square plan row and the round-1 azimuths after it. Not a reversal: a different knob from round 1.

finding.what: fdGap 50 helped by half: four of six pins now (16,736, 16,653, 16,665, 16,797), but 16,630 and 16,519 are still missing and two pins overprint their stacks.
finding.why: The last step of the same knob (top of its range) widens the row by about 11 % more; camObliqueZoom stays at 1.15 so the caption band stays clear at 29-31.5 s. If the pins stay at four, the cause is the label solver (film.js) and it is parked.

finding.what: camWideZoom 0.85 brought the cut readout into frame from 73 s, but its number is still clipped by the top edge at 71-72.5 s.
finding.why: A further step on the same knob, which acted on the problem; the 1,655 and tail cells at 77 s were well clear at 0.85, so there is room.
